title: Cell Biology Basics
description: Quick warmup before we dive into today's lesson! How well do you know your cells?

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate most of the cell's ATP through oxidative phosphorylation — that's energy currency!

questions.question: Which organelle contains the cell's genetic material?
questions.explanation: The nucleus houses DNA and controls gene expression. Think of it as the cell's brain.

questions.question: What structure gives plant cells their rigid shape?
questions.explanation: The cell wall (made of cellulose) provides structural support — that's why plants can stand upright without bones!

questions.question: Which organelle is responsible for protein synthesis?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes read mRNA and assemble amino acids into proteins. They're the cell's construction workers.

questions.question: What is the function of the cell membrane?
options: Control what enters and exits the cell
questions.explanation: The cell membrane is selectively permeable — it's the bouncer at the club, deciding who gets in and out.

questions.question: Which organelle breaks down cellular waste and debris?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes contain digestive enzymes that break down waste. They're the cell's recycling center.

questions.question: Where does photosynthesis take place?
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which captures light energy and converts it to glucose. Only in plant cells!

questions.question: What is the jelly-like substance that fills the cell?
questions.explanation: Cytoplasm is the gel-like fluid where organelles float and chemical reactions happen. It's basically the cell's internal ocean.
